response.sql: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) as avg_per_day FROM film WHERE rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_per_day) as overall_average FROM rating_averages) SELECT AVG(ra.avg_per_day) as avg_per_day_of_above_average_ratings, AVG(ra.avg_per_day - oa.overall_average) as avg_distance_above_threshold FROM rating_averages ra CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE ra.avg_per_day > oa.overall_average
